item.title: SCP-5196

item.title: Hear those Slay-Bells ring-a-ling
item.content:encoded:
And here we have my first foray into tale writing and into horror.

Admittedly, the length kind of got away from me, but overall I like it. Although I think that while I was aiming for 'unknowable supernatural horror', I may have strayed closer to 'generic slasher' but… hey, if movies like "Black Christmas" can become cult classics, maybe this can too?

I would also like to give a special thanks to SCP-4666 for being so goddamn creepy.

item.title: SCP-0110-J
item.content:encoded:
I am not sorry. The existence of this article is solely SCPD’s fault. All of the needed citation is provided in the Ayers Infomodule.

Edit: Alright, so I suppose this gets comments gets a bunch of new words now that I woke up. I think I should explain what the hell this is - two months ago, I said on SCPD that if SCP-5464 somehow reaches +100, I will write something whilst drunk, similarly to what PeppersGhost did with SCP-3943 after winning the SCP-4000 Contest. People only encouraged me of course. However, since I had no such beverages at my disposal, I thought that sleep deprivation is a good substitute. This is the product of that challenge.

~ read more of my garbage here ~

item.title: SCP-5968
item.content:encoded: This is probably fine as a -J, but as it stands it's a bit too non-serious to take seriously, but also not quite comedic enough to be very clearly -J. I suggest re-classification.

item.title: SCP-5739
item.content:encoded:
FIRST THING'S FIRST! There is a hidden message within the SCP-XXXX-1 instances and not everyone will find it on their first read. I'm disclosing it in the collapsable below, so consider this a warning if you'd like to go figure it out yourself.

Hidden Message
Hidden Message

The first letter of every line in an SCP-XXXX-1 instance spells out a phrase.

Okay, other things to note.

  • I drew the image and you can find more of my art here
  • Please leave a comment if you've got critique!

I think that's everything! Thank you for reading!
